# Glacier Creek Dental

> > Comprehensive dental practice in Fort Collins offering cosmetic, restorative, and family dentistry services with advanced digital technology and experienced dentists.

Glacier Creek Dental is a multi-dentist practice serving Fort Collins and Northern Colorado with a focus on comprehensive dental care, from preventive services to advanced cosmetic and implant procedures. The practice features four experienced dentists (Dr. Leavitt, Dr. Willey, Dr. Murri, and Dr. Folchert) and utilizes modern technology including E4D digital imaging and Invisalign systems.

## Cosmetic & Restorative Services

- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://www.glaciercreekdental.com/cosmetic-dentistry): Cosmetic dentistry services including implants, veneers, and crowns
- [Smile Makeover](https://www.glaciercreekdental.com/smile-makeover): Smile makeover service combining whitening, implants, and veneers
- [Dental Implants](https://www.glaciercreekdental.com/dental-implants): Dental implants service using titanium for tooth replacement
- [Porcelain Veneers](https://www.glaciercreekdental.com/porcelain-veneers): Porcelain veneers for smile enhancement and teeth improvement
- [Porcelain Crowns](https://www.glaciercreekdental.com/porcelain-crowns): Porcelain and ceramic crowns with digital x-rays for restoration
- [Cosmetic Bonding](https://www.glaciercreekdental.com/cosmetic-bonding): Cosmetic bonding procedure for smile correction and tooth restoration
- [Dental Bridges](https://www.glaciercreekdental.com/dental-bridges): Dental bridges service for missing teeth replacement solution

## Family & Preventive Dentistry
